main_text.l: uiter tetigisse visæ sunt : In templis contrà Pontificijs, vix quicquam vel dici vel peragi solet, cuius nos, illæsa mente, aut participes, aut vero testes fieri possimus : Enecant nos ipsi quidem parietes ; Cultum vero siue ridiculum, siue dæmoniacum quis ferat ? Honoramus nos (vti condecet) fœlicissimam sanctorum memoriam, inprimis vero præcipuam cœlicolarum, meritoque beatissimam, Virginem Deiparam ; & quicquid illa sibi, dominoque suo, non plane dedecori fore autumârit, id illi lubentissimè totum largiemur : neque modo Deum in sanctis

page.notes: The first word of the text is set as "uiter" (vitæ-form "uitèr" in print, read as uiter). Catchword "sanctis" is the first word of the following page; the text ends with the full line "mur : neque modo Deum in" and the word "sanctis" is a catchword that also begins the next line, so it is kept here only as the catchword. Some words in the scan are faint.
